levels.notes: Today's bot exactly: no overrides, so every value is the base file's (YOK-26/154/155 comparisons hold).

Proposed first pass: a player with a few runs behind them. Sees the screen 18 ticks late, decides every 6, about half the newcomer's mistakes, blocks 65% of seen threats, guards 60% of waits and in-range walks, anti-airs 35% of jumps. Everything else is the newcomer's.

Proposed first pass: a confident Kihon player. Sees the screen 14 ticks late, decides every 4, rare mistakes, blocks 80% of seen threats, guards 70% of waits and in-range walks, anti-airs 60% of jumps, and jumps and waits less. Everything else is the newcomer's.

notes: YOK-170 (designer 2026-10-20: the idle-guard default depends on the bot's level; several levels across runs). Each level overrides fields of the base bot file (data/harness/newcomer-kihon-bot.json); max_fight_ticks and menu_seconds_per_node stay the base's so levels compare. Every intermediate and skilled number is proposed for the designer and the Sparring Partner. The YOK-157 rule (the first jump seen under a held idle guard is let go) applies at every level.
